$comment: Each entry MUST carry a one-line `rationale` explaining why this
specific mutation is observably equivalent to the original (no test
could distinguish them). Bare entries are forbidden — if there's no
rationale, write the missing test instead.
Quarterly review: a maintainer audits entries and removes any whose
rationale no longer holds. Reflexive additions (silence a survivor)
are the wrong default; the right default is to write the test.
"rationale": "<one-line reason this mutation is observably equivalent>",
Initial state: empty. Populated as calibration and subsequent
release runs surface bona-fide equivalent mutants.
